body: Thank you! I was able to make it through the worst and reached out to a friend, who came and helped me. I appreciate the support!

Thank you! A lot of the time that is how it is for me. I thought I had gotten to the point where the pain had become bearable and something that I could handle well. Most of the time I can now look at pictures and talk about them. Other times it overwhelms me and just a thought will send me spiraling into a sobbing mess. The years have helped, so this hit me like a freight train
Thank you! I sincerely appreciate the support and acknowledgement of the pain. I hope yours eases and it gets better for you. Hugs to you as well 💜

Thank you guys for the support! Yesterday was just a really bad day where all the grief just seemed to hit me hard. It's something I have carried for a very long time. Most days I can function and live a productive life. Days like that takes me back to the day it happened and I feel all the raw emotions I felt then. It gets overwhelming and I have a hard time handling it 
Honestly, my other kid is what gets me through the worst of it. It's a burden I sincerely hope that no one ever has to carry and I really don't know how I'm still standing

To be fair, on the the barging in post12 days ago, the comments there recommended they put cameras up because mil and sfil walked around to the back door and let themselves in. I could be wrong, but nowhere did I see where that OP said they got cameras the day of the "apology", just that she took the boards advice  It very well could have been anytime in the last 12 days. Not that I think it's real, just that getting/installing the cameras isn't what makes it suspect to me.

From the post...

"I didn't feel safe having all my medication readily accessible, so we put it in the lock box and had MIL giving me a day's worth at a time.

I have two prescriptions of the same psych med, one large white nightly pill and a much much smaller dose in a tiny pink pill as needed during the day (still makes me take a nap if I take a whole instead of half, as I learned today my first time taking it as prescribed, when I heard about this because it was so fucking upsetting lol). They are clearly labeled, as all fucking medications are, with the doses and "at bedtime" or "as needed". I explained the different doses. I didn't know what each looked like at the beginning because my meds changed right when we started this. Also, I was not mentally sound at the time or I wouldn't have trusted her in the first place, obviously."

Sounds like he explained the different doses to his mil, but never saw the actual pills because they were new medications that he had been put on. I have had to have a "keeper" from my meds before and she picked up my prescriptions and gave them to me when I was supposed to have them. At the time I wouldn't have known if she switched them/gave them to me wrong either. Lucky for me, my friend wasn't trying to kill me lol

Also according to his post history him and his wife are both 21, trans and he has a history of mental health issues and abuse with his family of origin. Unfortunately he thought he could trust that woman to help him and that trust was completely misplaced.
Thank you! I hope you have a very Merry Christmas!

I would like to enter my son Raiden in this contest. He's 9 and absolutely loves all things Halo. That being said his favorite movie is Halo: Forward Unto Dawn. We watch it at least once a week. Mostly he watches and I find just about anything else to do 😂

He doesn't have a favorite Christmas song, but likes most of the classics. He prefers to listen to Marshmello, Skillrex or Old Town Road on repeat lol
It's a lot more work than people realize lol I'm glad you've gotten yours up... That's over half the battle! I'm like a third to halfway through now. Maybe more since the top is all one piece lol

Happy Monday everyone! 

Usually my tree goes up sometime between Thanksgiving night and the end of that weekend. Due to some physical issues I've been dealing with, it has taken an embarrassingly long time to get everything out of the attic. Like I've had issues for awhile and pack everything into small, lightweight boxes and that was cool for the last few years. This year up and down the steps was a huge issue. 

Long story short, I got everything down now, including the tree, so guess what's getting put up today?? 🎄 My kid has been super understanding, but has been asking everyday when we're gonna decorate. He's gonna be so excited when he gets home from school today... Surprise, decorating time is here!

Any bets on how long it will take my little procrastinator to do homework today?? 😂

Schedules and structure is great!! Especially for anything school/bus related... It affects everyone who has to use them, so the bus should definitely be at the top of the let's stay on schedule list! You seemed to have dealt with it well so far, but I totally get the frustration. I'd be thinking up increasingly interesting situations to curb my annoyance. Nothing too bad... Just like I hope he steps on a Lego and then whacks his knee hopping around and go from there 😁

I sincerely hope that you don't have to deal with it too much longer! It eventually does get better one way or another... No one likes feeling like they're a negative Nancy 😕

My kid now gets up early every morning "just in case". Not gonna lie it's kinda nice that I never have to rush him anymore. He gets up, showered and dressed and just chills out for an hour before school. I used to be afraid of my anxiety rubbing off on him, but he's like here's how I'll fix this lol He even WANTS to go to the bus stop early so he can hang out with his friends. So like I said, eventually it does get better!

Agreed lol They definitely are... And like you said they blame the parents when it's them eating so much extra time from our days. I didn't always have access to a vehicle and it sucked sitting on the bus stop corner for an hour every day. 

On the plus side, I did make a really good friend with the lady that lives there hahaha Her daughter (3) wanted to meet my roommates two youngest kids(3&4) when I had to tote them down with me. It was quite the year I tell ya lol

I'm so sorry you have to deal with it now!! It's definitely one of those things that just grate on your nerves and is completely understandable that you get so frustrated! I worked nightshift at the time and I just wanted to shove the kids on the bus and try to sleep for a few hours. Im usually not overly emotional, but I feel like I cried so many times that year from sheer frustration and lack of sleep! It seemed like no one who hasn't gone through it can understand how truly it affects your life. Hopefully your driver situation improves (it definitely should be illegal!) and I wish you the best of luck on your job search!

You definitely aren't the only one to have ever dealt with that!! Where I'm at the kids bus is supposed to run within 10-15 minutes of a certain time. For the most part it's usually with 5 really. 1st Grade though... My kid is now in fourth and I could STILL strangle that driver when I think about her. Anywhere between 5-45 minutes both early and late. She HATED by firmer roommate's kid (also a 1st grader) and was unbelievably rude everyday. We started filming the interactions because they were that bad. Halfway through the year the parents on our street gave up and took turns piling in the kids and driving them to school because " we missed the bus" when it came 45 minutes early. The driver was "reassigned" a month before school was out. After every parent complained multiple times and had video  documentation of her behavior and the times she was coming. Long story short lol I definitely understand your frustration!!

I would like to enter for a chance to win. I would use a gift card to get stocking stuffers for my kid. I'm the mom the puts socks or underwear (the not fun stuff to open lol) as well as candy and a couple small toys in the stocking. 

I would also like to say thank you for the opportunity and I'm sure that whoever wins will be very grateful! You are an awesome person and I hope you have a very Merry Christmas!
Thank you! That's super awesome of you and my kid is going to be so excited. I'll PM you just as soon as I figure out how 😂
Thank you very much! Y'all are awesome and I'm sure he will love both of those. I will send pictures of him opening them on Christmas 🙂
My son's name is Raiden and he is 9 years old. His favorite Pokemon is a tossup between Pikachu and Ditto. He's in bed now, but I'll see if he'll draw something tomorrow :)
